latest.headline: Tu Mil Jaaye: KING's first song is out on SRK's 61st birthday
latest.deck: Released at 00:09 IST on 2 Nov 2026, the minute SRK turned 61. Sachin-Jigar compose, Kumaar writes, Arijit Singh and Madhubanti Bagchi sing, and Ed Sheeran features. Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone star. In its first half hour on YouTube: 260,084 views and 40,324 likes.
latest.quote: Yeh Daur Ishq ka Naseeb Waalon ko milta hai... Jahan Barood ki Khushboo mein Gulab khilta hai... Of Love and other Battles....This December, #LoveLikeAKing
